summary.text: Chris Rose is a Republican member of the West Virginia Senate from District 2, listed with Monongalia County; the district covers Wetzel, Tyler and Doddridge counties and parts of Marshall, Marion and Monongalia. His legislative page lists him as chair of the Energy, Industry and Mining Committee.

paragraphs.text: Rose's page lists degrees in mechanical engineering (B.S.) and electrical engineering (A.S.) and names his spouse as Amber.
It lists his affiliations as the National Rifle Association, Gun Owners of America, WVCDL, the WV Farm Bureau, West Virginians for Life and Tea Party Patriots.

Rose also sits on the Senate's Agriculture, Confirmations, Government Organization, Health and Human Resources, Judiciary, Natural Resources and Workforce committees and on the Select Committee on School Choice.
Between sessions he chairs the interim Energy and Public Works committee.
